newsitem.title: USA: Gryphon seen as buyout target-Business Week.
newsitem.headline: Gryphon seen as buyout target-Business Week.

text.p: Property and casualty insurer Gryphon Holdings Inc is a possible takeover target, an investment manager told Business Week.

Jim Awad, who runs the investment firm Awad & Associates Asset Management, said that it's only "a matter of time before somebody comes in and buys Gryphon," with the company underperforming and its stock trading around 15 a share.
The company's president, Stephen Crane, admitted that Gryphon is vulnerable to a buyout raid unless the company boosts its stock price.
The stock closed Thursday at 16-3/8, up 3/4.
Officials from Gryphon were not immediately available to comment.
